verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a feedback-to-tasks product like Canny. However, the evidence documents no review or approval gate for a task's scope before work begins. The closest features are status updates and sending feedback to Jira, Linear, GitHub and similar tools with status sync. These are adjacent workflow controls, not a documented scope-approval step.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can review and approve the scope of a task before any work begins on it
